data.name: Kowloon Story 2 | 九龙诡录2
data.detailed_description:
Kowloon Story 2

⚠️ This is not just a game — it’s a middle-aged man’s life-or-death night shift.

Midnight of Ghost Festival, Kowloon Walled City, full curfew.

Everyone hides from spirits, but you must work — for your family, for your daughter, for your stubborn refusal to give up.

With only a flashlight and the will to survive, you patrol, inspect, and unravel strange incidents.

⚠️ Every step brings you closer to the truth… and death.

No cruel puzzles, no cheap scares — just a story-driven Hong Kong horror experience, polished over 3 years for 2.5+ hours of immersion.

QQ Group: 751344212

Features

  • 👮 First-Person Security Simulation: Real night shift immersion

  • 🌃 Hong Kong Ghost Festival Vibe: Authentic Kowloon Walled City horror

  • 🧩 Gentle Puzzles: No frustration, focus on story & emotion

  • 😱 Psychological Horror: Unsettling atmosphere, no cheap jump scares

  • ❤️ True Developer’s Story: Theme song by the developer, from a middle-aged man’s struggle

How to Play

First-person horror + security simulation walking simulator.

WASD = Move | F = Flashlight | E = Interact | Q = Investigate | SPACE = Next Dialogue

Survive the midnight shift in Kowloon as a middle-aged guard, solve puzzles, and make it to dawn.

Developer’s Message

I’m no pro — just a 40-year-old laid-off man refusing to quit.

My first two games failed, but for my daughter, I had to stand up.

This game isn’t a blockbuster, but it’s my real struggle and determination.

For anyone fighting low points, protecting loved ones — this is for you.

We’re not successful, but we’ll never surrender.

— 40 Year Old Rapper (Independent Developer / /Father)

Warning

⚠️ Contains psychological horror, disturbing elements & oppressive atmosphere.

Brave enough? Turn off the lights for full Kowloon terror!

Get release notifications & support a father fighting for his daughter.
